'''L3-R3''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
L3-R3 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as the Imperial quest giver for the "[[Raid on Rakata Prime|Legacy of the Rakata]]" Flashpoint.<ref name="TOR" />
